description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Vayne''' gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 30 '''bonus''' movement speed while facing a nearby [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], increased to 90 while under the effects of ''[[File:Vayne Final Hour.png|20xpx|border|link=Vayne#Final Hour|An icon for Vayne's ability Final Hour]] [[Vayne#Final Hour|Final Hour]]''.
description.text: Innate: Vayne gains  30 bonus movement speed while facing a nearby visible enemy champion, increased to 90 while under the effects of Final Hour.

notes.raw: * The '''bonus''' movement speed persists for 2 seconds after '''Vayne''' loses [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of an enemy champion.
notes.text: The bonus movement speed persists for 2 seconds after Vayne loses sight of an enemy champion.
